agent.name: Steward
agent.role: Looks after your repositories: claims versions, merges your ready pull requests and releases, where you say yes
agent.description: Looks after the repositories of yours that you pick from the ones Reeve finds on this PC: claims each new version up front so parallel work never collides, watches your pull requests and releases, merges your ready, green pull requests and releases new versions, each only where you say yes.

roles.title: Steward
roles.description: The steward ran the household and its servants: took them on, taught them the ways of the house, and passed the lord's orders down to them. Here the steward keeps your repositories in order: versions claimed before the work starts, ready pull requests merged, and new versions released, as you allow.
